title: Class 7 'jellyfish' outruns the Little Bird helicopter

tellings.quote: Uh, we have a video of how we fly on "jellyfish" 7th grade, and she changes course, goes windward,

plain: The team at Skywatcher, a startup that says it can call up UFOs and record them, says it has video from 2025 of chasing a "jellyfish", the seventh class of object in its own sorting scheme, with a Little Bird, a small helicopter. They tell Michels the object changed course and headed into the wind, outrunning the helicopter, which if true would mean it was moving under its own power rather than drifting like a balloon.
